meaning:
1) to play or sound the timbrel, beat, play upon, drum (on a timbrel or other object)
1a) (Qal) playing (participle)
1b) (Poel) beating (participle)

elsewhere.note: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
